status: architectural proof contract; physical VS11 acceptance remains separate
architecture_assumptions: MCS51 hardware interrupt entry pushes a two-byte return PC and marks the interrupt priority in service.
An active interrupt cannot be preempted by an interrupt of equal or lower priority; fixed-priority active sources cannot reenter before RETI.
RETI clears the in-service state; ordinary RET does not.
VS11K28A executes the checked OEM wrapper opcodes with these MCS51 semantics.

primary_source.author: Intel
primary_source.title: MCS-51 Microcontroller Family User Manual, February 1994
primary_source.claims: Equal-or-higher in-service blocking, hardware-generated LCALL and RETI behavior.

reasoning: Exact OEM wrappers use standard register saves, bank0, indirect callback calls, and RETI; these bytes support treating MCS51 interrupt semantics as an explicit target architecture contract, rather than inferring an exact VS11 priority count.
With three enabled sources, fixed priority settings and no early RETI, each active source occurs at most once. Every active chain is an ordered nonempty subset of the three sources.
There are 3+6+6=15 such chains. Summing every per-source maximum covers every chain even when distinct maxima are unreachable together.
Adding each callback bound to17 accounts for its hardware PC frame, thirteen OEM saved registers and OEM callback call.
CPU injections at callback entry verify preservation for all15 orders; the static sum bounds arbitrary nesting phases.
source_and_image_checks: Native variant/protected region validation and exact OEM wrapper instructions.
Shared stack analyzer validates listing/IHX bytes and rejects unresolved callback control flow.
Reachable callback instructions cannot write IP/IP_EX or execute RETI.
Linked instructions cannot select another register bank or enable sources outside Timer0/USB/LED.
Shared helper foreground calls are confined to linear initialization with EA or USB interrupt disabled.
Timer/USB allocations cannot use OSEG or overlap another allocation in the same address space.
LED selector mask is checked structurally and all256 source-byte values execute with expected native-valid and bounded abnormal behavior.
remaining_limits: Architectural compatibility is an assumption; no physical VS11 interrupt acceptance or timing test was performed.
Global main-path stack bound and CRT entry frame must be combined separately.
Live USB ACK effects and hardware frames are explicitly supplied in the CPU model.
Foreground/IRQ protocol state concurrency still depends on its explicit synchronization, beyond allocation non-overlap.
